query:
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  candidate1_bio = 'Hallie Shoffner is an Arkansas Democrat and attorney who has worked in public interest law and civil rights advocacy. She is challenging incumbent Republican Senator Tom Cotton in what is expected to be a heavily Republican-leaning race in Arkansas.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Tom Cotton is a Republican U.S. Senator from Arkansas who has served since 2015, known for his hawkish foreign policy positions and strong support for military spending. He previously served one term in the U.S. House of Representatives and is an Army veteran who served in Iraq and Afghanistan. Cotton is considered a potential future presidential candidate within the Republican Party.'
WHERE state_code = 'AR' AND status = 'General';

UPDATE senate_races SET 
  candidate1_bio = 'Juliana Stratton is a Democrat who has served as Illinois Lieutenant Governor since 2019 under Governor J.B. Pritzker. She previously served in the Illinois House of Representatives and is known for her work on criminal justice reform and equity issues. Stratton is running for the open Senate seat being vacated by retiring Democratic Senator Dick Durbin, who has held the seat since 1997.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Don Tracy is an Illinois Republican attorney and businessman who has been active in state Republican politics. He is challenging in the heavily Democratic state of Illinois for the open Senate seat vacated by retiring Senator Dick Durbin. Tracy faces a significant uphill battle in a state that has not elected a Republican U.S. Senator since 1998.'
WHERE state_code = 'IL' AND status = 'General';

UPDATE senate_races SET 
  candidate1_bio = 'Scott Colom is a Mississippi Democrat and circuit court judge who has served on the bench in northeast Mississippi. He previously served as a district attorney and is known for his work on criminal justice reform. Colom won the Democratic primary to challenge incumbent Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in what is expected to be a heavily Republican-leaning race.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Cindy Hyde-Smith is a Republican U.S. Senator from Mississippi who was first appointed to the seat in 2018 and subsequently won special and regular elections. She previously served as Mississippi Commissioner of Agriculture and Commerce and as a state senator. Hyde-Smith is the first woman elected to represent Mississippi in Congress and is seeking her third full term in the Senate.'
WHERE state_code = 'MS' AND status = 'General';

UPDATE senate_races SET 
  candidate1_bio = 'Rachel Fetty Anderson is a West Virginia Democrat and attorney who is challenging incumbent Republican Senator Shelley Moore Capito. She has worked in legal and advocacy roles in the state. Anderson faces a significant challenge in West Virginia, one of the most Republican-leaning states in the nation.',
  candidate2_bio = 'Shelley Moore Capito is a Republican U.S. Senator from West Virginia who has served since 2015, making her the first woman elected to the Senate from West Virginia. She previously served six terms in the U.S. House of Representatives and is the daughter of former West Virginia Governor Arch Moore. Capito serves on the Senate Appropriations Committee and is known for her work on infrastructure and energy issues.'
WHERE state_code = 'WV' AND status = 'General';
